get.description: Lists humans on this instance, ascending by id. `?type=` narrows to one registration type; `?id=a,b,c` fetches a specific set in one request (unknown ids are omitted, not an error). Combining them intersects. Returns a summary per human — use GET /v2/humans/{id} for the full resource.

parameters.description: Filter to one registration type, e.g. webhook or discord:user. Omit for every type.
parameters.name: type

schema.description: Filter to one registration type, e.g. webhook or discord:user. Omit for every type.

parameters.description: Comma-separated ids to fetch, e.g. id=123,456 — the same form as the bulk tracking delete's uid=. Unknown ids are omitted rather than erroring. Omit to list everything.
parameters.name: id

schema.description: Comma-separated ids to fetch, e.g. id=123,456 — the same form as the bulk tracking delete's uid=. Unknown ids are omitted rather than erroring. Omit to list everything.

delete.description: Removes the human along with every tracking rule, profile and summary schedule they own. Irreversible. 404 if the human does not exist. Triggers a state reload.
delete.summary: Delete a human and all their data

get.description: Returns the full human resource. blocked_alerts is a read-only derived field. 404 if the human does not exist.

Returns every profile for the human (profile_no, name, area, location, active_hours). active_hours is a typed JSON array of schedule entries ([] when no schedule is set). 404 if the human does not exist.

post.description: Creates a new profile (profile_no auto-assigned). active_hours, if provided, is validated against the strict schema (numeric bounds + step/end cross-field, no cross-midnight) and stored as JSON. 422 if the name is empty or active_hours is invalid; 404 if the human does not exist. Triggers a state reload.

get.description: Returns the geofence areas available to this human (community-filtered when area_security is enabled). 404 if the human does not exist.

post.description: Stores the requested areas, lowercased and deduped, after matching them against the fences this human may select (userSelectable for non-admins, community-filtered when area_security is enabled). Names that do not match come back in `rejected` rather than being discarded silently. Set `trusted: true` to select non-userSelectable fences on behalf of a user whose client has already authorised the change; unknown names are still rejected. Writes the human's active profile by default; `?profile=` targets another and `?all_profiles=true` writes every profile the human owns (the two are mutually exclusive). Triggers a state reload. 404 if the human does not exist.

parameters.description: Profile number to write; defaults to the human's active profile. Mutually exclusive with all_profiles.
parameters.name: profile

schema.description: Profile number to write; defaults to the human's active profile. Mutually exclusive with all_profiles.

parameters.description: Write the same areas to EVERY profile the human owns. Use when a fence has been deleted and must be dropped everywhere. Mutually exclusive with profile.
parameters.name: all_profiles

schema.description: Write the same areas to EVERY profile the human owns. Use when a fence has been deleted and must be dropped everywhere. Mutually exclusive with profile.

post.description: latitude/longitude are taken from the BODY (v1 took them from the path). When area_security is enabled and the human has an area restriction, the location must fall inside an allowed fence (403 otherwise). Triggers a state reload. 404 if the human does not exist.

parameters.description: Profile number; defaults to the human's active profile
parameters.name: profile

schema.description: Profile number; defaults to the human's active profile

delete.description: Deletes the profile and its tracking data. The store reassigns the human's active profile when the deleted one was active (mirrors v1). 404 if the human does not exist. Triggers a state reload.

patch.description: Partial update: send `name`, `active_hours`, or both — omitted fields are left unchanged. The schedule is validated against the strict schema (numeric bounds + step/end cross-field, no cross-midnight); an empty [] clears it. 422 on an invalid schedule or a body with neither field; 404 if the human does not exist. Triggers a state reload.
patch.summary: Update a profile's name and/or active_hours

post.description: Copies all tracking rules from from_profile (body) into the {profile_no} destination, replacing the destination's existing rules (mirrors v1 CopyProfile). 404 if the human does not exist. Triggers a state reload.

parameters.description: Destination profile number to copy tracking rules INTO
parameters.name: profile_no

schema.description: Destination profile number to copy tracking rules INTO

ping.description: Text appended to the alert, typically Discord role/user mentions. Stored verbatim — not restricted to mention tokens as the bot is, so @everyone/@here in a channel rule will ping. Omit for none. Returned as null when empty.

areas.description: Requested area names. Matched case-insensitively against the fences this human may select; duplicates are collapsed and anything unmatched comes back in the rejected list rather than being dropped silently.

trusted.description: Set true to select fences that are not userSelectable — for a server-side client that has already authorised the change (e.g. the user drew the fence). Honoured because the caller holds the API secret. Unknown fence names are still rejected.

active_hours.description: New active-hours schedule ([] clears it, omitted leaves it unchanged). Validated against the strict schema.

name.description: New profile name. Omit to leave it unchanged.

boss.description: Catch-all for boss encounters: set true to match only boss invasions (stored grunt_type "boss"). One-of mode field. Mutually exclusive with the others; gender not allowed.

clean.description: Auto-delete the alert on expiry (clean bitmask bit 1). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

distance.description: Radius in metres around the anchor location. Omit (or 0) to match by the profile's geofence areas instead of a radius — 0 means area-based, NOT zero metres (stored as 0). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

edit.description: Keep the message updated in place (clean bitmask bit 2). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

everything.description: Catch-all wildcard: set true to match EVERY invasion (stored grunt_type "everything"). Equivalent to omitting every mode field, which is the wildcard; set it explicitly when you want the intent on the wire. Mutually exclusive with the others; gender not allowed.

gender.description: Grunt gender filter: any|male|female. Omit to match any gender (defaults to 'any', stored as 0). ONLY valid together with type_id. Returned as null when 'any' (or when not in type_id mode).

grunt_id.description: Game-master grunt id; resolves to that grunt's name and implies its own gender. One-of mode field. Mutually exclusive with the others; gender not allowed. Read-back reports the rule as grunt_type, because that is what is stored — see grunt_type.

grunt_type.description: The stored targeting value, and the ONE targeting field every read emits. Accepts any grunt name the bot accepts: a pokemon type ("water"), a named grunt ("giovanni", "blanche", "mixed", "npc_0"), or a catch-all ("everything", "boss"). type_id and grunt_id are input conveniences that resolve to one of these. Pokestop-event names are not valid here — use /incident. Enumerate valid names from GET /api/masterdata/grunts. One-of mode field; may be combined with gender.

override_areas.description: Restrict this rule to these geofence areas (mutually exclusive with distance > 0 and override_location_label). Omit for none. Returned as null when unset.

override_location_label.description: Saved-location label to use instead of the profile location (requires distance > 0; mutually exclusive with override_areas). Omit for none. Returned as null when unset.

summary.description: Route into the summary digest (clean bitmask bit 4). Omit to disable (default false). Returned as null when false.

template.description: DTS template name. Omit (or empty) to use the server's configured default template (stored as ""). Returned as null when at its wildcard.

type_id.description: Pokemon type id (1-18); grunt_type resolves to that type's lowercased name. At most one mode field may be set — this OR grunt_id OR grunt_type OR everything OR boss. Omitting all of them matches EVERY invasion (stored "everything") — blank is the wildcard, as elsewhere in v2. In responses, the active mode field is always present; the other mode fields are omitted/null.

step.description: Step in hours; >0 makes this a range entry, 0/absent = single-fire

active_hours.description: Optional active-hours schedule (absent or [] = no schedule)

profile.description: The created profile. Omitted only when the post-insert read-back failed; profile_no is still authoritative.

profile_no.description: The profile_no assigned to the new profile — the LOWEST FREE number, which the caller cannot predict

admin_disable.description: Whether an admin has disabled this account; such a user must re-register

current_profile_no.description: The profile currently active for this human

disabled_date.description: When the destination was disabled. Null while enabled; pairs with admin_disable so a disabled account shows when.

enabled.description: Whether the user has alerts switched on (the !start/!stop flag)

id.description: Human id (Discord/Telegram id, or webhook name)

language.description: Alert language code, empty when the user has not chosen one

last_checked.description: When reconciliation last verified this destination. Null if never checked — admins sort on this to find dormant accounts.

type.description: Registration type, e.g. discord:user, discord:channel, webhook, telegram:user

from_profile.description: Source profile number to copy tracking rules FROM

active_hours.description: Auto-switch schedule as a typed array. Always [] when unscheduled (never null, never a string).

area.description: Profile geofence-area override. [] when the profile has no area override.

latitude.description: Profile location-override latitude. 0 when the profile has no location override.

longitude.description: Profile location-override longitude. 0 when the profile has no location override.

profile_no.description: Profile number within the human (1 = default profile); referenced by tracking rules and profile switch.

uid.description: Database row id of the profile.

areas.description: The areas now stored, lowercased and deduped

rejected.description: Requested names that were NOT stored — unknown fences, or fences this human may not select. Empty when everything applied.
